execution: Apply exactly one semantic mutation, run its witness, require an assertion failure (not import/build/syntax failure), restore, then continue. This audit edited files only; it did not run tests or mutants.

mutants.name: paid-price
mutants.mutation: Replace the tester writer's item price with price_pro.

mutants.name: automatic-collection
mutants.mutation: Use charge_automatically instead of send_invoice in the tester writer.

mutants.name: attach-card
mutants.mutation: Attach or set pm_saved on the tester customer before creating the subscription.

mutants.name: omit-cancel-at
mutants.mutation: Omit cancel_at from the tester Subscription.create arguments.

mutants.name: thirty-day-month
mutants.mutation: Compute ends_at as started_at plus 30 days instead of the clamped next calendar month.

mutants.name: accept-unknown
mutants.mutation: Accept an empty exact-code match list, using promo_b184 as a fallback.

mutants.name: skip-active
mutants.mutation: Remove the promotion active check.

mutants.name: skip-tester-tag
mutants.mutation: Remove the metadata tester=true check.

mutants.name: skip-expiry
mutants.mutation: Remove mandatory future expires_at validation.

mutants.name: allow-expiry-equality
mutants.mutation: Change expires_at <= now refusal to expires_at < now.

mutants.name: skip-cap
mutants.mutation: Remove mandatory positive max_redemptions and times_redeemed < max checks.

mutants.name: skip-coupon
mutants.mutation: Ignore coupon.valid and coupon product restrictions.

mutants.name: trust-price-id
mutants.mutation: Accept configured tester price id without validating the retrieved price properties.

mutants.name: skip-repeat
mutants.mutation: Ignore applied tester redemptions and permit another redemption.

mutants.name: org-only-repeat
mutants.mutation: Restrict the durable one-use lookup to org_id, ignoring the authenticated user in another org.

mutants.name: skip-local-plan
mutants.mutation: Skip the local manual/Stripe entitlement conflict check.

mutants.name: skip-stripe-live
mutants.mutation: Ignore listed live Stripe subscriptions when redeeming.

mutants.name: first-item-only
mutants.mutation: Inspect only items.data[0] when deciding whether a subscription belongs to DevGenie.

mutants.name: ignore-open-checkout
mutants.mutation: Skip the open paid Checkout-session refusal in tester redemption.

mutants.name: bypass-admin
mutants.mutation: Call _require_org without admin=True in the tester route.

mutants.name: scope-before-admin
mutants.mutation: Run billing:write scope enforcement before _require_org(..., admin=True).

mutants.name: skip-tester-scope
mutants.mutation: Remove billing:write scope enforcement from the tester route.

mutants.name: trust-body-identity
mutants.mutation: Accept body org_id/user_id/price_id and use them instead of rejecting extra fields.

mutants.name: no-user-unique
mutants.mutation: Remove the user_id uniqueness constraint (from model and migration for a coherent runnable mutant).
mutants.expected: The second concurrent INSERT must wait for the first transaction and then raise 23505 naming uq_tester_redemption_user. Removing uniqueness lets it complete and fails the blocking assertion.

mutants.name: no-user-lock
mutants.mutation: Remove .with_for_update() from the User SELECT in BillingService._tester_lock (the reported mutant a).
mutants.expected: same-user-two-orgs must block on the held User lock before reading reservations. The mutant reaches the empty-read gate and fails the positive blocking assertion; uniqueness does not mask this lock witness.

mutants.name: no-org-unique
mutants.mutation: Remove the org_id uniqueness constraint from both model and migration for a coherent runnable mutant.
mutants.expected: The org_id duplicate INSERT completes instead of blocking and failing with uq_tester_redemption_org.

mutants.name: no-org-lock
mutants.mutation: Remove .with_for_update() from BOTH the Organization and Subscription SELECTs in BillingService._lock (the reported mutant b), retaining refresh and normal execution.
mutants.expected: two-admins-one-org reads past the holder, or the explicit org blocker is bypassed; pg_blocking_pids evidence is absent and an assertion fails.

mutants.name: omit-discount
mutants.mutation: Omit the actual promotion_code discount from tester Subscription.create.
mutants.expected: Both accounts have passed the stale last-slot check on separate PostgreSQL transactions. Omitting the discount bypasses the external cap; the wire and single-external-success assertions detect it. Stripe cap enforcement is modeled, not live-tested.

mutants.name: new-idempotency-key
mutants.mutation: Generate a fresh idempotency key on each retry instead of using the reservation UUID.

mutants.name: refresh-retry-end
mutants.mutation: Recompute the next-month end at retry time instead of using the pending reservation end.

mutants.name: forget-pending
mutants.mutation: Delete or roll back the durable pending reservation after an unknown Stripe create outcome.

mutants.name: eligibility-before-recovery
mutants.mutation: Move fresh-code eligibility/live-plan checks before pending subscription recovery.

mutants.name: active-only-recovery
mutants.mutation: Leave confirmed cancelled/ended pending redemptions pending rather than consuming them as applied.

mutants.name: ignore-pending-tester
mutants.mutation: Remove the narrow pending-tester guard from ordinary paid checkout.

mutants.name: omit-local-end
mutants.mutation: Write the tester Subscription with current_period_end=None.

mutants.name: extend-tester-end
mutants.mutation: Let authoritative Stripe current_period_end/cancel_at extend the tester row beyond stored ends_at.

mutants.name: copy-tester-ending-flag
mutants.mutation: Copy Stripe cancel_at_period_end=false into a matched durable tester row.

mutants.name: delete-redemption-on-cancel
mutants.mutation: Delete the consumed TesterRedemption when its subscription is cancelled.

mutants.name: accept-event-snapshot
mutants.mutation: Reconcile a tester subscription from webhook data.object rather than authoritative gateway retrieval.

mutants.name: omit-redemption-migration
mutants.mutation: Make upgrade a no-op while keeping valid migration metadata and imports.

mutants.name: drop-user-unique
mutants.mutation: Omit user_id uniqueness from the migration but retain it in model metadata.

mutants.name: skip-redemption-commit
mutants.mutation: Skip the transaction commit that finalises applied redemption and local Pro before returning 200.

mutants.name: accept-tester-checkout
mutants.mutation: Allow the tester price through paid checkout when it overlaps STRIPE_PRICE_MAP.

w4_execution: From C:/localcode/uam-b184 with B184_TEST_DATABASE_URL set to a disposable postgresql+asyncpg database, select -k tester_w4 for all W4 cases or -k tester_w4_postgres for the PostgreSQL witnesses. Unset URL skips PostgreSQL witnesses with an explicit message; a skip is not acceptance.
